positions.name: MeridianAnalyticsAdoption
positions.frame: which database platform meets our analytics pipeline performance and streaming ingestion requirements?
positions.why: Quinton Fairweather and the team re-evaluated Zypherion and committed to adopting Meridian for analytics due to native batch and streaming ingestion capabilities, formally superseding the prior Zypherion analytics decision while maintaining the Q3 2026 migration window.
